'''The Sy-Y ''' was a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-producing [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] and the spice-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] world of [[Syvris/Legends|Syvris]]. It was used by the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] to quickly move spice from its Ylesia factories into [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] distribution.

==Astrography==
The Sy-Y began at [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] and ended at [[Syvris/Legends|Syvris]].<ref name="LoNH" /> It intersected the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']] at Ylesia, and the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]] and the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] at Syvris.<ref name="TEA" />
